review_runs.summary: Reviewed all selected keyed sources. Lesson clearly teaches and practises the help-seeking sequence, with valid Bokmål and answerable exercises. Defects: two learner-facing level references, one comprehension activity that supplies its input in English, and one unclosed quotation. Inspected all 5 exercises; each serves obj-ask-for-help-01. checkpoint_identify_situation tests recognizing an obstacle; checkpoint_choose_obstacle practices stating an obstacle; checkpoint_build_approach practices stating an obstacle and requesting help; checkpoint_listen_next_action tests understanding helpful responses; checkpoint_complete_sequence integrates stating an obstacle, requesting help, and accepting the proposed next action.
